meta.title: Required average strength f'cr rules
meta.source: CIE308 Ch4 Part B slides (Dr. M. Tawk), after ACI 211.1; verify against ACI 211.1-91 and PCA Design and Control of Concrete Mixtures

units.values: MPa unless the key says otherwise

meta.notes: f'cr = max(f'c + 1.34 s F, f'c + 2.33 s F - 3.45). No data: +7.0 if f'c < 21; +8.5 if 21 <= f'c <= 35; +10.0 if f'c > 35. n < 15 -> standard deviation treated as unknown. Approved as D-1.
